ns2:section.sectionText: This section is a placeholder, and cannot be registered. To register for a section with a specific faculty member, please contact them first for permission. If they approve, have them email stat-grad@illinois.edu (copying you as well) with your name and UIN indicating their approval, and you will be provided with the CRN to add. Registering for this course without instructor approval can result in a failing grade. For general Statistics course registration information: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration
